task.title: Exporting reports
task.shortdesc: Download intake, outcome and medical data for board reports, grant applications and industry reporting such as Shelter Animals Count.

chrow.chdesc: Counts by species, type and outcome. Matches the Shelter Animals Count format.
Average and median days from intake to outcome.
Vaccinations, treatments and surgeries by date.
Hours by volunteer and shift type.

step.cmd: Set the date range and, if you have several sites, the site.
Click Export and choose CSV or PDF.

result.p: Small reports download immediately. Larger ones are emailed to you as a link that expires after 7 days.
